result.title: Celebrating Hispanic Heritage Month
result.description:
Sabor, historia, y puro ritmo 💃 🎶 In honor of Hispanic Heritage Month, the #GoogleDoodle is spotlighting the evolution of Latin pop through the legendary Gloria Estefan and her classic hit “Rhythm Is Gonna Get You.”

From salsa and bachata to cumbia and dembow, Latin pop carries generations of rhythm in every beat, full of history, heart, and the kind of energy you feel before you even know the lyrics.

It’s the rhythm we all get – and the rhythm that gets us all. 

Featuring AJ Ramos, Head of Artist and Label Partnerships for Latin Music & Culture at YouTube Music

result.title: Google’s latest moonshot to put machine learning in space
result.description:
A solar panel in space generates up to 8 times more power than one on Earth.

That’s the vision behind Project Suncatcher: Google’s moonshot to capture continuous sunlight and more efficiently power machine learning in space. 

In this video, we explore some of the monumental engineering questions that must be answered to make this idea a reality.

0:14 - How do we put machine learning in space?
0:30 - How much power can solar panels generate in orbit?
0:55 - How do TPU satellites communicate?
1:40 - What is the future of space-based compute?

Read more about Project Suncatcher on News from Google: https://goo.gle/4xEzOOp

result.title: Why this college professor is embracing AI
result.description:
Meet Dr. Sawa Kurotani, a professor at the University of Redlands who believes knowing how to use AI is an essential skill for every student today. In her upcoming college course, Living and Learning with AI, she's using AI Mode in Google Search to show students how artificial intelligence can genuinely support their education. Her mission: inspire more schools to embrace AI as a powerful learning tool.
